data.why: The app requires two identically-shaped binary MRC half-map volumes; the repo ships none, and this prep step can only author text files, not valid binary MRC data (same limitation noted for images), so no fixtures could be produced here.

goals: determine the resolution of a 3D cryo-EM reconstruction from two independently reconstructed half maps using the FSC 0.143 criterion
quantify voxel-level uncertainty in the FSC curve at each spatial frequency shell via confidence intervals, rather than trusting a single resolution number
compare three statistical approaches (Fisher z-transform, bootstrap resampling, analytical variance) to see how the choice of method affects the confidence envelope
tune the statistical stringency of the envelope by adjusting sigma (and bootstrap sample count) to match a desired confidence level
export the computed FSC curve with upper/lower bounds as a CSV for downstream reporting or plotting

review.summary: The goal matches the README, the setup part of the tree is accurate, and every screen I opened shows what its node says. But the run had no half maps, so the tree never reaches the FSC curve, the 0.143 resolution reading, the comparison of methods, or the CSV export (the main purpose of the tool), and it needs a second run with real data before it can be filed.
